note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 35, CUB 8(a); A06b Const 35, CUB 8(a); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Cuba, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Cuba for 5 years. ... n.a. ... n.a. (Constitutional provision states that citizenship is not lost if another citizenship is acquired.)
